old_caption: The video captures a lively dance class taking place in a spacious studio with wooden flooring and mirrored walls. The instructor, positioned at the front, is energetically leading the class through a series of dance moves. Dressed in a black sleeveless top and colorful shorts adorned with smiley faces, the instructor demonstrates fluid arm movements and rhythmic steps. The participants, a mix of adults and children, follow along enthusiastically, mirroring the instructor's actions. Their attire varies, with some wearing casual workout clothes while others opt for more colorful outfits. The room is well-lit, with natural light streaming in from large windows on one side, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The mirrored walls reflect the dancers, adding depth to the scene and emphasizing the synchronized movements. The overall ambiance is one of fun and engagement, capturing the essence of a dynamic dance class in progress.

caption: The video captures a man in a black sleeveless shirt and pink graffiti-print shorts standing with his back to the camera in a dance studio with a mirrored wall and wooden floor. He faces the mirror, which reflects his front view and a row of class members. He stands with his feet together and hands behind his back. He lifts his right heel, bends his elbows, and raises both hands toward his head. Stepping his right foot out to widen his stance, he holds his arms raised above his shoulders. He lowers his arms while keeping his legs apart and lifting his left foot, then brings his feet together with his hands resting near his hips. Shifting his weight, he rotates slightly and steps with his left foot. He raises both arms to head level again, legs apart, before extending them horizontally to the sides. The mirror shows his own front view tracking his movements, while the reflected class members stand watching, some holding up phones.
